questions.question: As systems scale, Xu emphasizes adding operational tooling such as:
options: Deleting logs so disks stay empty during incidents.
Logging, metrics, and automation to run the system.
Manual SSH only with no metrics ever collected.
Disabling alerts so on-call never wakes up.

Ban metrics because they encourage premature optimization in real production systems at scale.

User-visible symptoms (errors, latency, saturation) that need action.

Increase QPS without adding any capacity in real production systems at scale.
